note: City of Nelson park. 4-5 back-in concrete-pad sites; a 36-ft Class A has fit, so easy for a 23-ft rig. Pay cash at the city office (580 S Main, with the fire station, ~3 blocks away), or the after-hours slot there; no drop box at the campground. Camper-reported $15 a night (2024 and 2025). RV dump station on West 8th St. Restrooms, playground, disc golf and pool in the park. --Claude
summary: The city's recreation page confirms overnight camping at Harbine Park with electric, water and sewer, and an RV dump station on West 8th Street; it posts no rate and no camping phone. Water and sewer are written. The city clerk's phone is (402) 225-4401 (contact page). Pin is at the end of the gravel park drive south of the pool, under canopy; pads not visible. Not waterfront.
